verdicts.reason: A is mostly a scaled-down copy of the original: the can roundel is clipped at the bottom edge, the subline is close to illegible at 50px, and the NEW pill floats in the gap without belonging to anything. Still, its pill-shaped Try It CTA and its left-to-right banner order hold together. In B, Try It has become a squashed dark circle jammed against the top, bottom and right edges, and NEW is crammed against the end of the tagline so the two collide. The can roundel is clipped there too, so B looks more cramped and less like the original's spacing.
